# testdata

`trgm_similarity_fixture.json` is generated by running
`verify_backfill_trgm_similarity.py` against a live Supabase instance (see
that script's docstring for the required manual pre-step). It is not
checked in with real data by default -- `test_backfill_trgm.py`'s live-
fixture test skips gracefully if this file is absent.
